facts.statement: Property is 18 Thistlevaunt Lane, Orvelune, ZZ1 1ZZ and is vacant; post-tenancy items are kitchen/oven/extractor degreasing, bathroom and en-suite limescale, waste removal from the kitchen, rear garden clearance including bagged dog waste, and soil disturbed by digging.

No visit date has ever been confirmed; the contractor said next availability was the following week (10 Sept) and agreed to wait, and later asked whether the hold still applied.
As of 25 September the instruction was to wait three more working days for the separate major maintenance to be completed; no maintenance completion date is recorded anywhere in the file.
No artefact in the case records testing of smoke or carbon monoxide alarms at the property; the move-out report lists preparation items only.

- The quotation includes carpet shampooing to Bedroom 1, stairs and landings, which was not in the inspection preparation list and was not itemised in our 8 September approval request.

Please reply within 3 working days. The work is on hold meanwhile and no visit is booked.
